entries.title: Job 42:3
segments: Men know very little about the character and ways of God, except as he reveals them; and when they attempt to go beyond his revelation, they darken counsel by words without knowledge.

entries.title: Job 42:4
segments: Hear, I beseech thee; Job humbly asks God to listen to his inquiries, and teach him the truth concerning Himself and his ways.

entries.title: Job 42:5
segments:
I have heard of thee; he had had dark and indistinct views of God. 
 
  Now mine eye seeth thee; his views of God were more clear and distinct. 
 
Closer views of the character and will of God, and right feelings towards him, will lead men to abhor their sins, and heartily to turn from them to him, whose favor is life, and whose loving-kindness is better than life.

entries.title: Job 42:6
segments: Wherefore I abhor myself; on account of my sins.

entries.title: Job 42:7
segments:
As my servant Job hath; Job's general doctrine concerning God and his providence, though maintained with much impatience and infirmity of spirit, was yet correct; and it was more honorable to God than the doctrine of his friends. 
 
The Lord will in due time vindicate his servants from the aspersions which men have wrongfully cast upon them, and bring forth their righteousness as the light, and their integrity as the noonday.

entries.title: Job 42:10
segments:
Turned the captivity of Job; removed his calamities, and restored his prosperity. 
 
The end of a good man is more blessed than his beginning; and the darkness and distress of the night will be followed by the light, the joy, and the glory of a cloudless and eternal day.

entries.title: Job 42:11
segments:
Did eat bread with him; a token of restored kindness and friendship. 
 
Many who neglect a man, or stand aloof from him in adversity, will return to him and be very friendly and kind in prosperity.

entries.title: Job 42:16
segments: Let a man be patient under trials: if reviled, not revile again; hold fast his integrity, commit himself to Him that judgeth righteously, and justify God in all his ways, and his end will be peace and his eternity blessed.
